[06:08] Maya Chen: From a pricing perspective we provide per-token pricing for hosted, committed capacity pricing for Dedicated (monthly commit) and enterprise licensing for Private. Dedicated gives you predictable throughput and slightly lower per-token unit. Private is fully self-managed, though we have an on-prem bundle.
[06:35] [00:06:35] Diego Ramos: For forecasting, can we run a simulation to show cost at different batching/quantization settings?
[06:45] Ethan Cole: Yes — Optimize recommendations include suggested batching and quantization profiles per model. In the Console there's a Cost Simulator: input expected concurrency and batch size, it will estimate latency and cost. We'll share a pre-filled sheet for your routes.
[07:05] Liam O'Connell: Can we do a pilot that routes heavy-traffic endpoints to Dedicated and leaves low-traffic to Hosted to save cost?
[07:14] Ethan Cole: Absolutely. We support smart routing by policy — latency-critical traffic to lower-latency Dedicated or regionally close-hosted, and background batch jobs to cheaper instances. It can auto-fallback if Dedicated capacity is saturated.
